findings.proof: Actual installed public pipe rejects all tested desired-access masks; a separate current-user public fixture with exact production SDDL reproduces failure. Adding only0x80 yields0x100083 and succeeds. Adding onlyREAD_EA,WRITE_EA,WRITE_ATTRIBUTES orREAD_CONTROL does not. Live service/private data not modified.
